brief: Taiwan's equity market keeps printing fresh all-time highs even as investors debate whether the AI trade has run too far, because retail is buying, foreign positioning stays light, and the semiconductor cycle keeps accelerating rather than slowing. GS notes margin balances have risen for 10 straight sessions, with TWSE just 0.2% below its record and TPEx already at one, while leverage relative to market cap stays below July's highs, implying room left to run. JPM argues the earnings backdrop remains intact with steady EPS revisions and no capex downturn being priced in, citing TSMC's 100%+ utilization at N3/N5 as validation. Taiwan IC revenues, after growing about 23% last year, are seen surging 41% in 2026; Franklin Templeton puts consensus Taiwan EPS growth above 50% in 2026. JPM notes foreign investors sold aggressively over the summer and remain underpositioned despite the rally, and estimates 55% of TWSE market cap has positive Apple exposure, historically adding about 9% to forward EPS revisions in the three months after major Apple upgrade cycles. TSMC says customer engagement on leading-edge nodes now starts two to three years out. JPM likes buying Dec 2026 TWSE 110% calls as Taiwan vol has normalized.
